t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two baskets which correspond to two different groups of gnomes. Blue, orange, green and yellow are one group/one basket, the other coloured gnomes are the other. Flip between them until you find the highest score and stick with that group until the numbers start to fall again, then switch to the other group and repeat.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes wearing green, blue, orange and yellow caps correspond to one colour of basket in the woods (yellow). The brown, purple, red and pink gnomes correspond to a different basket (red). Swap between the groups until you find the one with the highest scores and stick with that one until the scores begin to fall again, then switch to the other group. At times both groups will provide low scores, keep swapping until you hit on higher scores again.
